content.short: Zokyo provides web3 security services to help organizations protect blockchain-based systems from cyber threats.
content.description: Zokyo is a web3 security firm dedicated to helping organizations that use blockchain technology stay secure from cyber threats and remain confident in their readiness. It delivers dynamic web3 cyber defense and economic solutions by pairing services and products backed by industry-leading expertise, intelligence, and innovative technology. Zokyo's approach combines technical security with strategic insights to address the evolving risks facing smart contracts and digital systems. Founders and developers trust Zokyo to keep these systems secure, reliable, and resilient in the face of emerging threats.
